noun_definition: Expense refers to a financial transaction that is being manually tracked within the application, specifically in the context of a user submitting a record of spending.
Members count refers to the number of active users associated with a transaction thread, which should reflect the presence of users in the Members list during expense tracking.
nobody refers to the absence of any active users in the Members list of a transaction thread, indicating that there are no user comments present.
Members list refers to the section in the transaction thread that displays active users associated with the expense, which is expected to show at least one member if there is an active user present.
